title: Mainsah et al. 2025 — bigP3BCI: An Open, Diverse and Machine Learning Ready P300-based Brain-Computer Interface Dataset (Study G)
description: Study G of the bigP3BCI collection, comprising EEG recordings from 20 healthy participants using a 9x8 character grid P300 speller with checkerboard/dynamic stimulus presentation. Data were recorded with 16 channels at 256 Hz and annotated with HED tags for target and non-target events. The dataset is a MOABB-derived version of the PhysioNet bigP3BCI resource, intended for machine learning and benchmarking of P300-based brain-computer interfaces.
methods_description: EEG was recorded from 16 channels (standard 10-20 montage) using a g.USBamp (g.tec) amplifier at 256 Hz in a laboratory setting. Participants used a P300 speller with a 9x8 character grid and online feedback, with calibration followed by test sessions. One session per subject.
